title: Ronald V. Dellums Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance
requirement: Rental housing providers in Berkeley may not ask about or use criminal history or background checks in advertising, applications, tenant selection or decision-making, and may not refuse to rent or terminate a tenancy based on criminal history.
coverage_conditions: All rental housing providers in Berkeley, except listed exemptions.

conditions.who: owner-occupied, owner of record resides as primary residence

applicability.per_tenancy: Exemptions for units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back (BMC 13.76.130 A.9), units occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates, lifetime sex offenders, and public housing/Section 8 properties.
coverage_quotes: Owner-occupied properties (between 1-3 units) in which an owner of record resides in one of the units as their primary residence
Units occupied by existing tenant(s) seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates
Units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back to their home in accordance with BMC 13.76.130 A.9

exemptions: Lifetime sex offenders; public housing/Section 8 properties (limited exemptions); owner-occupied properties of 1-3 units where the owner resides as primary residence; units under a rental agreement allowing owners to move back; units occupied by existing tenants seeking to sublet or add/replace roommates.
penalty: Administrative fines of at least $1,000 and up to $10,000 per violation, civil damages including actual damages or three times one month's rent, punitive damages, attorneys' fees and costs, and injunctive relief.
quoted_span: The Fair Chance Access to Housing Ordinance prohibits rental housing providers in Berkeley from asking about and using criminal history and/or criminal background checks in their rental housing advertising, applications, tenant selection process, or decision-making.
